title: Training instructor's account of 'ghosts' using the Nellis weather station restroom
summary: Charles Hall tells of Training instructor's account of 'ghosts' using the Nellis weather station restroom, about c. 1964-1965 at Old weather station, base operations building, Nellis AFB, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Old weather station, base operations building, Nellis AFB, Nevada

tellings.quote: ghosts, you and I would say a group of five tall white aliens had come in off the runway off the the tarmac

plain: Charles Hall says he worked as a weather observer at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada around 1964 and 1965, and he wrote about it in his book Millennial Hospitality. On Jesse Michels's podcast he says that the airman training him told him about "ghosts" using the restroom in the old weather station. Hall says those ghosts were really a group of five tall white aliens who had come in off the runway, which would mean the base staff knew about the visitors and had a polite word for them.
